description: Code Engine projects. Start here: action list gives the project names and ids that every other ce_* tool takes as project_id (a name works when it is unique across regions). Also reports status, resource quotas, and egress IPs. Call get_schema with name ce_project for every action's fields.

action.description: list: List projects in every region, or one region. | get: Get one project. Needs project_id. | status: Show readiness and enabled components. Needs project_id. | quotas: Show used vs limit for CPU, memory, instances, apps, secrets, and more. Needs project_id. | egress_ips: List public egress IPs for firewall allowlists. Needs project_id. | create: Create a project in a region. New projects take about a minute to become active. Needs name, region. | delete: Delete a project and everything in it. Needs project_id.

namespace.description: Optional: project namespace (subdomain) override, if it cannot be auto-derived.

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

region.description: IBM Cloud region (omit to search all regions)

name: ce_project
